item.title: Blackstone bar owner sues state over 'barber shop' name dispute
item.description: Nebraska bar owner files federal lawsuit against state barber board over using "barber shop" in business name without a barber license in First Amendment fight.

item.title: Omaha Public Schools faces $50.6 million budget shortfall after state error
item.description: OPS faces a $50.6 million budget shortfall for the 2026-2027 school year after a Nebraska Department of Education error resulted in an overpayment in aid for this school year.

item.title: Omaha Skutt's Kaylyn Harrill, Yutan's Jordyn Campbell each win third girls' wrestling state titles
item.description: 🏆 What a day at girls' state wrestling finals! Among the champions: 3-time winners Kaylyn Harrill & Jordyn Campbell plus back-to-back champ Kaylynn Lyons! 💪
